why: v1.7 LEAD-DERIVED (F2, POLICY-SPEC 14.4): for a deny rule a drive letter on only one side is ignored, so C:/workspace/secrets/k counts as inside the root /workspace/secrets (on Windows /workspace resolves against the current drive) and file.deny-secrets matches. The effect was deny before and is deny now; only the reason changes. Relabelled by the lead from the spec change, not by the blind labeller. Original request retained.
